apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription:
File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. No jailbreak and no kernel exploit.

• Browse every app's data container, app groups, extension and daemon containers
• Plist editor and hex viewer/editor; edits are backed up first
• Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import files and whole folders
• Syntax highlighting, SQLite viewer and media player
• Back up, restore and clear app data; AirDrop backups as ZIP
• Cache cleaner

iOS 26 and 27 (tested on 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2.1; on iOS 26, System Data and System Groups are not available). Needs a signer that keeps the App Group entitlement (AltStore, SideStore or Impactor; not Sideloadly).

versions.localizedDescription: Optional App Store icons for other apps (Settings → App Store Icons), fixes apps with one-word bundle ids (like Pinterest) and the empty gap above the Apps list on iOS 27, and keeps the Backups tab working on iOS 27 beta 5.
Custom inspectors (read-only JavaScript, install from a .zip), your own folders and files in the Cache Cleaner, and Japanese.
Fixes LiveContainer setups where every folder was refused, SQLite restore with -wal files, lossless SQLite and plist edits, and backups listed newest first.
Works inside LiveContainer again. Cache Cleaner: Clean is ready after a scan, plus Invert Selection. Wi-Fi uploads stop with sharing.
Recognizes iOS 27.3 beta 2+, where Apple patched worse_query. The access cache repairs itself when another app in the App Group broke it.
Show Folder Sizes, empty folder hints, Colored Cards with a pickable color, themed tiles; WQ Files is back in the Files app; fixes wrong app names on iOS 26.5 and the Crash Logs note.
Apps and Cache Cleaner scans are fast again (more than twice as fast as 0.9.11 and 0.9.12).
Wi-Fi Sharing: browse, download and upload files from any browser on the same Wi-Fi. Themes with importable .wqtheme files, Recent folders and files, progress bars, and a fix for a frozen screen.
Vietnamese translation. Apps and Clean scans keep running across tabs and app restarts, with Pause/Resume and a spinner or clock in the tab bar.
Fixes installed apps missing from Apps, App Data and Extension Data (e.g. on iOS 26.5).
App Groups now show their names on iOS 27.2+. Plain Background option, dark and tinted app icon, files you can't open are dimmed, and a clear notice on iOS 18 and older.
Reset Access Cache is now in Settings → Troubleshooting (both designs). The Log explains why access is blocked and logs a repeated failure only once.

New design: Home with container cards, tabs for Apps, Clean and Backups, Settings behind the gear. The previous design stays available (Settings → New Design). New screens translated into every language.

New: Search Inside Folders, Largest Files, Get Info, Duplicate, Copy to Folder, Favorites, Reopen Last Folder, update notice, Extract and Open for ZIPs, Thai. Safer SQLite save and app restore. Fixed: app backups could come out empty; app names and missing app folders on iOS versions with an unknown app database layout.

New: iOS 27.3 beta, Turkish, flags in the language list, Replace All when importing several files, Rename in Select, restore edited backups. Many safety fixes from a code review (folder delete, SQLite backups, ZIP, hex and plist editors, media).

New: delete folders with everything in them (backed up, restorable), Polish and Russian, filters in App Data, version in the device strip, Reset Access Cache. Fixed: backups with sockets, Share as ZIP of app folders, app names.
New: startup check (stops with what failed instead of empty lists when access breaks), Recently Deleted under Backups. Cache Cleaner progress bar.
New: edit SQLite databases (Edit, then Save writes back with a backup and integrity check). Korean translation. Fixed: Arabic corrections, empty app lists after an iOS update.

Now in Simplified Chinese, Arabic, German, Italian and Spanish, with a Language setting. New: Import as Backup, Keep Data Before Restore, media streams instead of copying, offloaded apps and App Bundles (iOS 27). Apps and the Cache Cleaner reopen instantly.

Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import several files or whole folders. New: syntax highlighting, media player, Apps filter, bundle IDs and Copy Bundle ID, restore from App Backups, Allow Deleting and Show Item Counts settings. Fixed: iOS 26.5 app list, deleting locked files. Signing: use AltStore, SideStore or Impactor (Sideloadly drops the App Group).

Apps show up in seconds on every iOS version (no more long first scan); full scans only when needed and after you agree. New: sorting, A–Z sidebar, read-only SQLite viewer, swipe to delete, signing check at launch. Preliminary iOS 26 support.
iOS 27.2: app names are back. iOS 26 (26.0 – 26.7.2) is supported. Faster scans that are remembered, swipe to delete in the file browser, and a more detailed Log.
Cooler, faster scans (one shared pass, fewer cores); manage and delete backups, stop a cache clean, cancel ZIP exports; checked backups and restores; signing help in the README. Requires iOS 27.
AltStore/SideStore source; safer saves and restores (rollback, interrupted-restore recovery, no overwriting changed files); Log shows version, device and iOS.
Plist editor, hex viewer/editor, Open As, search bar, Home button, readable paths.
Safer backups and restores; large files are streamed.
Fixed: apps you installed were missing.
First release.

apps.name: Tetherless (Modern)
apps.subtitle: Firma y administra aplicaciones en iOS 26+
apps.localizedDescription: Herramienta para firmar e instalar IPA directamente desde el iPhone. Edición Modern para iOS 26 y posteriores. La fuente no está afiliada a sus desarrolladores.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Sign much bigger apps — and old universal apps

- **Multi-gigabyte apps** now sign on-device without running out of memory. The whole pipeline — unzip, hash, sign, repackage — streams to and from disk, so even a **3.5 GB** app signs and installs. Large apps also sign **noticeably faster** (each file is hashed once per sign).
- **Older 32/64-bit "universal" apps** now sign correctly — Tetherless keeps the 64-bit slice your device actually runs and drops the dead 32-bit one.

## Decryption improvements

- A decrypted app is now saved as a **clean, fully-decrypted build**, so it sideloads with **any** tool, not just Tetherless.
- Apps with tiny helper frameworks (e.g. Firebase's) no longer stop the decrypt partway through.

## Clearer errors

- When signing can't finish, Tetherless shows the **actual reason** instead of a generic "check Diagnostics" message.

---

**Which build?** iOS 26 and later → **Modern**. iOS 17.4–18 → **Legacy**.

## Cleaner, unified lists

Files, Unsigned, Signed, and Installed now use one consistent grouped list — rows share a single frosted surface instead of each sitting in its own separate card.

## Files browser

- **Filter & sort** — a new control (top-right) to sort by date added, name, size, or kind, and to show only folders, IPAs, images, archives, or text files.
- Long file and folder names now **wrap** onto up to three lines instead of being cut off at one line.
- Files and Installed now show when each item was **added / installed**, newest first.

## Signing

- Fixed signing a Mach-O that has **no existing code signature** — Tetherless now adds the signature slot itself, so unsigned binaries sign correctly instead of failing with "this Mach-O has no existing code signature to replace".

---

**Which build?** iOS 26 and later → **Modern**. iOS 17.4–18 → **Legacy**.

## Optimized for iPhone Duo

Tetherless now fills the full inner display on Apple's foldable **iPhone Duo** and adapts as you fold and unfold — instead of running in a letterboxed window. (Modern build; iOS 26 devices are unaffected.)

## Smaller improvements

- **Decrypted files are named clearly** — a decrypted app saves as `AppName-<version>_Decrypted.ipa`, and an exported unsigned IPA as `AppName-<version>_Modified.ipa`, so versions don't collide.
- **Custom-certificate mode:** the bundle-identifier field is now directly editable (pre-filled with the app's original id) — no more "Automatic" toggle that didn't apply in that mode.

---

**Which build?** iOS 26 and later → **Modern**. iOS 17.4–18 → **Legacy**.

## Automatic refresh (new)

Set up a **Shortcuts automation** and Tetherless re-signs every sideloaded app — and itself — on a schedule, in the background, **even while your iPhone is locked**. No more manually resigning every 7 days. See **Settings → Automate Refresh** for the one-time setup (Enable LocalDevVPN → Refresh All Apps), and there's a new **Refresh All** button in **Library → Installed** to do it by hand any time.

## Multiple Apple IDs for the App Store

Sign several Apple IDs in for downloads and switch between them right in the **Decrypt** tab. Manage them in **Settings → Store Access**. Your main signing Apple ID is still used automatically.

## Fixes

- Version history now loads reliably (including right after a fresh launch), and opens from a clear button instead of a hidden long-press.
- Fixed a duplicate "Tetherless" row in **Installed** after an in-app update.

---

**Which build?** iOS 26 and later → **Modern**. iOS 17.4–25 → **Legacy**.

## Tetherless 1.2.0

### New
- **Manage your Apple ID in the app.** A new **Settings → Developer Account** screen shows your signing certificates, App IDs, and devices — and lets you **revoke a certificate** to free up a slot, without opening the Apple Developer portal or another tool. Certificates created by other tools (Xcode, SideStore, …) are clearly labeled, and revoking the one Tetherless currently signs with warns you first.

### Downloads
- **Modern** — iOS 26 and later: `Tetherless-1.2.0-Modern.ipa`
- **Legacy** — iOS 17.4–25: `Tetherless-1.2.0-Legacy.ipa`

Not sure which? iOS 26 or newer → Modern. Otherwise → Legacy.
